finding: Same-encode media feature reuse is physically available, but libmtmd's returned float pointers alias mutable context- or batch-owned vectors and are not persistent embedding identities. Frank requires an explicit PEH ownership/lifetime/invalidation layer; COPY_ON_CAPTURE is the safe reference baseline, with zero-copy permitted only after a version-bound ownership-fence test proves correctness and net benefit.
negative_result: A naked mtmd output pointer is rejected as durable perceptual state, UnifiedDB evidence, replay identity or cross-encode asynchronous handle.
architecture_effect: Refines QNDRF-1.1; no canonical promotion. Adds PEH lifetime and ordered Q0/Q1/D0/D1 geometry obligations.
